data.overview: When the first artificial satellite crosses the night sky, coal miner's son Eli Harper becomes determined to build rockets in his Appalachian hometown. His dream brings him into conflict with his practical father, but a few encouraging teachers help turn backyard experiments into a path toward the stars.
data.tagline: Sometimes one dream can light the whole sky.
data.title: A Sky Full of Rockets
